meaning: Line 64 sets the vessel wall constitutive law: transmural pressure (in.p - ext.p) follows a two-exponent law k*((A/A0)^b1 - (A/A0)^(-b2)) in area. It defines how the collapsible segment's area responds to pressure, which feeds resistance (line 65), volume (line 66) and the wall flow ext.q (line 67).

could_move.what: Fitted parameter values for m5 (k, b1, b2, A0 and anything compensating through R and V)
Model-vs-data agreement in the single-model patient comparison
Cross-model comparison plots against m1, m4 and m6, since only the m5 branch changes
Reported curves and numbers in the fitting report for the patient decks
Solver behaviour: the (A/A0)^(-b2) term grows without bound as A approaches zero, so collapse cases may stiffen or fail

expectation: Unknown. The law is strongly nonlinear in A, and through R ~ 1/A^2 (line 65) a small change in the exponents can shift both operating area and pressure drop. I cannot tell direction or size from this context.

check.why: Runs the existing verification for this model only, so it re-solves and checks a fit without paying for a full re-fit across all 12 decks.
